definitions.explanation: The overall standard of well-being, comfort, and satisfaction in a person's daily life. Commonly used in medical, social welfare, and policy contexts.

examples.japanese: {生活|せいかつ}の{質|しつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧⟦させたい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve my quality of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生活|せいかつ}の{質|しつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧。
examples.english: This treatment greatly improves the patient's quality of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生活|せいかつ}の{質|しつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Community support is essential for maintaining the quality of life of the elderly.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated as QOL (キューオーエル) in medical and welfare contexts. Frequently discussed in relation to healthcare, aging, disability support, and urban planning. The English abbreviation QOL is widely understood in Japanese professional settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生活|せいかつ}の{質|しつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ (to enhance quality of life)

- {生活|せいかつ}の{質|しつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧ (to maintain quality of life)
